info.title: Admin API
info.description: Back-office APIs for platform administration: insurance category configuration, application review, card lifecycle management, eligibility recording, doctor-patient assignments, and the audit trail. Admin has the broadest access of any role, so several Citizen/Doctor endpoints appear here too.

get.summary: Gets the cross-patient application queue: every application, optionally filtered by status, paginated.
get.description:
Call this to build an Admin review queue/dashboard - unlike every other read endpoint in this
controller, this one is not scoped to a single patientId, so it's the entry point for
discovering applications an Admin doesn't already have a patientId/applicationId for (e.g. filter
?status=Submitted to see everything currently waiting to be picked up). Restricted to Admin.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Optional. Filter to applications currently in this status - e.g. "Submitted" to build a
            "needs review" queue. Omit to return every status.

200.description: Returns the matching page of applications (empty if none match).

get.summary: Gets everything an Admin needs to decide on one application, in a single call.
get.description: Call this to open an application for review - pairs with Approve/Reject below (GET to see everything and claim the case, then Approve/Reject to record the decision). Restricted to Admin. Returns the applicant's identity and profile (Admin has no other endpoint that exposes this), the category applied for, the documents and dependents actually captured in this application's submission snapshot (not the citizen's current state, which may have changed since), current eligibility/verification, and the full review history with InternalNotes always included. Replaces calling the separate Documents/Dependents/Eligibility/Verification endpoints one by one - Admin no longer has access to those directly (they remain Patient/Doctor self-service endpoints). Side effect: if the application is currently Submitted, this call itself claims it by advancing it to UnderReview (recorded exactly like a manual PATCH .../review with NewStatus=UnderReview would be) - so opening the case is enough; there is no separate "start review" step, and Approve/Reject become callable right after this returns.

patch.summary: Sends an application back to the citizen for more documents.
patch.description:
Call this from an Admin case-review screen when something submitted is missing, illegible, or
otherwise insufficient. Restricted to Admin. Requires the application be currently UnderReview
(open it via GET .../review first, which auto-claims a freshly-Submitted one).
CitizenVisibleReason is required - it's the citizen's only signal for what to fix. Creates an
immutable ApplicationReview row (ReviewOutcome = NeedMoreDocuments); does not touch Eligibility
or Verification.

example.citizenVisibleReason: The uploaded Employment Letter is illegible - please re-upload a clearer scan.
example.internalNotes: Original scan is too dark to read the company letterhead.

200.description: Recorded. Returns the updated application (Status = WaitingForDocuments).

400.description: CitizenVisibleReason is missing, or a field exceeds its max length.

409.description: The application is not currently UnderReview.

patch.summary: Resumes review of an application after the citizen has uploaded more documents.
patch.description:
Call this once the citizen has responded to a WaitingForDocuments request and the Admin is ready
to look at it again. Restricted to Admin. Requires the application be currently
WaitingForDocuments. No body - uploading more documents does not move the status by itself; this
is the explicit "I'm looking at it again" action. Creates an immutable ApplicationReview row
(no concluded outcome yet, same as the auto-claim on GET .../review).

200.description: Recorded. Returns the updated application (Status = UnderReview).

409.description: The application is not currently WaitingForDocuments.

patch.description: Call this from an Admin case-review screen once everything checks out. Restricted to Admin. Requires the application be currently UnderReview - open it via GET .../review first, which auto-claims a freshly-Submitted application (advances it to UnderReview) so this becomes immediately callable. Creates an immutable ApplicationReview row and captures read-only Eligibility/Verification snapshots - neither is modified or triggered by this action. Also automatically issues the citizen's (and any dependents') digital insurance card - no separate manual step is needed; the citizen can retrieve it via GET /api/insurance/cards/current/{patientId} right after this returns. Card issuance is best-effort: if it fails for some reason, the approval itself still stands, and POST /api/insurance/cards/issue/{applicationId} remains available to issue it manually.

example.internalNotes: Employment letter confirmed with HR department.

400.description: A field exceeds its max length.

409.description: The application is not currently UnderReview.

patch.description:
Call this from an Admin case-review screen when the application cannot proceed. Restricted to
Admin. Requires the application be currently UnderReview (open it via GET .../review first, which
auto-claims a freshly-Submitted one). CitizenVisibleReason is required - it's shown to the
citizen so they understand why. Creates an immutable ApplicationReview row and captures read-only
Eligibility/Verification snapshots - neither is modified or triggered by this action.

example.citizenVisibleReason: The submitted Employment Letter is expired - please upload a current one.
example.internalNotes: Letter dated 2023, more than 3 months old per policy.

400.description: CitizenVisibleReason is missing, or a field exceeds its max length.

409.description: The application is not currently UnderReview.

post.summary: Logs in with NationalId and password.
post.description:
Call this from the login screen every time a returning user signs in. Works for any role -
Patient, Doctor, or Admin - since all three are checked by NationalId. Anyone (unauthenticated)
may call it. Returns the same generic error for an unknown NationalId or a wrong password, so
callers cannot use this endpoint to enumerate which national IDs are registered.

200.description: Credentials valid. Returns a JWT and the user's basic info.

post.summary: Issues a JWT for an existing account without checking a password. Development environment only.
post.description:
Not for frontend use - QA/tooling only, to skip typing a password while exploring the API in
Swagger. Returns 404 outside the Development environment, so it can never be reached in
production. Pass any seeded or registered NationalId and get back a valid token instantly.

200.description: Account found. Returns a JWT and the user's basic info.

404.description: No account with this NationalId, or the API is not running in Development.

get.summary: Returns the identity of the currently authenticated user, as read from their JWT.
get.description:
Useful for a frontend to confirm a stored token is still valid and see who it belongs to (e.g.
on app startup, before showing a logged-in UI). Requires a valid Bearer token from
/register, /login, or /test-token - any authenticated role may call it.

200.description: Returns the caller's identity as read from the JWT claims.

patch.description:
Call this to temporarily block a card from verifying (e.g. suspected misuse) without
            permanently revoking it. Restricted to Admin. Active -> Suspended. Reason required.

example.reason: Citizen reported the card as lost.

409.description: The card is not currently Active.

patch.description:
Call this once the reason for suspension is resolved. Restricted to Admin.
            Suspended -> Active.

409.description: The card is not currently Suspended.

patch.description:
Call this to permanently invalidate a card (e.g. fraud, eligibility loss) - unlike
            Suspend, this cannot be undone. Restricted to Admin. Active/Suspended -> Revoked. Reason
            required. Terminal.

example.reason: Citizen reported the card as lost.

409.description: The card is already terminal (Revoked or Superseded).

post.summary:
Renews a card - issues a fresh successor with a full new validity period and supersedes the
predecessor.
post.description:
Call this before/as a card approaches its ExpiresAt date. Restricted to Admin. Requires
            the card be Active - a Suspended card should be Reactivated or Revoked first, not renewed. Does
            not require a new InsuranceApplication; the successor inherits the predecessor's
            ApplicationId.

example.reason: Citizen reported the card as lost.

200.description: Renewed. Returns the new successor card.

409.description: The card is not currently Active.

post.summary:
Replaces a lost, damaged, or stolen card - issues a fresh successor and supersedes the
predecessor.
post.description:
Call this when a citizen reports their card lost, damaged, or stolen. Restricted to
            Admin. Requires the card be Active or Suspended - never Revoked (revocation can never be
            bypassed via Replace) or already Superseded. Carries the predecessor's own ExpiresAt forward if
            still in the future; otherwise grants a fresh full validity period.

200.description: Replaced. Returns the new successor card.

409.description: The card is not currently Active or Suspended.

patch.summary:
Rotates a card's VerificationToken in place - the QR/NFC payload becomes invalid; the card
itself (CardNumber, ExpiresAt) is unchanged.
patch.description:
Restricted to Admin. No new row is created and Status does not change - use this when
            only the embedded secret is suspected compromised (e.g. a photographed QR), not when the
            physical/digital artifact itself needs replacing (use Replace for that).

200.description: Rotated. Returns the updated card (TokenVersion incremented).

409.description: The card is not currently Active or Suspended.

post.summary:
Issues cards for an Approved application - one for the Patient, plus one for each dependent that
was part of that application.
post.description:
Approving an application (PATCH /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/approve) already
calls this automatically - you normally don't need to call it yourself. This endpoint exists as
a manual fallback for the rare case where that automatic issuance didn't happen or failed (e.g.
a transient error at approval time). Restricted to Admin. Only reads InsuranceApplication.Status
(never writes to it). Rejects with 409 unless the application is Approved, or if the relevant
scope already has a non-terminal card.

409.description: The application is not Approved, or a non-terminal card already exists for this scope.

post.summary: Verifies a scanned card token - the hospital/point-of-care check-in action.
post.description:
Call this when a citizen presents their digital card (QR/NFC scan) at a point of care. Restricted
to Doctor + Admin, matching Insurance Verification's point-of-care precedent. Takes only an
opaque VerificationToken (never raw card data). The response is deliberately minimal - no
NationalId, Address, Mobile, or internal Id, even for an authenticated caller.

403.description: Caller is neither Doctor nor Admin.

get.summary: Gets every card a patient (and their dependents) has ever held, newest first.
get.description:
Call this for a card history screen. Restricted to Admin - a citizen's own "My Card" screen
should use GET .../current/{patientId} instead, which is the only card endpoint left available
to a Patient token. Card history/lineage (superseded/revoked cards, and why - see GetDetail's
status-change history) is Admin-only: unlike Application review reasons, a card status change's
Reason field has no CitizenVisibleReason/InternalNotes split, so it isn't guaranteed to be
citizen-appropriate text.

200.description: Returns the card list (empty if none).

get.summary: Gets full card detail, including its status-change history.
get.description:
Call this for a single card's detail screen, including its full lifecycle audit trail (every
Suspend/Reactivate/Revoke/Renew/Replace, with the Admin-entered Reason for each). Restricted to
Admin - the Reason text on a status change is free-form Admin input, not guaranteed to be
citizen-appropriate (no CitizenVisibleReason/InternalNotes split like Application reviews have).
A citizen's own current card is available via GET .../current/{patientId} instead.

get.summary: Gets the patient's own currently active card.
get.description:
Call this to show a citizen their own current, usable card (e.g. a "My Card" screen with
            a QR code) - this is the only card-read endpoint a Patient token can call; GetCards/GetDetail
            above are Admin-only. Access is Admin (any patientId) or the Patient themselves (own patientId
            only). Returns only a card that is Status == Active and not yet past ExpiresAt, scoped to the
            patient's own card (not a dependent's).

404.description: No such patient, the caller has no access, or no currently active card exists.

get.summary: Gets a patient's applications, newest first.
get.description:
Call this to show a citizen's application history. Access is Admin (any patientId) or
            the Patient themselves (own patientId only) - no Doctor access.

200.description: Returns the application list (empty if none).

404.description: No such patient, or the caller has no access to this patientId.

get.summary: Gets full application detail, including its review history.
get.description:
Call this for an application detail/case screen. Same access rule as the list endpoint.
            InternalNotes on each review entry is populated only when the caller is Admin.

404.description: No such application, or the caller has no access to it.

get.summary: Gets full application detail by its human-readable reference number.
get.description:
Same access rule and detail shape as the Guid-based detail endpoint - for citizens/staff
            who only have the printed/spoken reference number (e.g. "APP-2026-00000015"), such as a support
            call or a printed confirmation.

404.description: No such application, or the caller has no access to it.

get.description: The Admin management view for building a category-editing screen. Restricted to Admin.

Any authenticated caller may call it - e.g. to show full detail after the citizen taps a

Updates an insurance category's identity fields (Code/Name/Description/DisplayOrder) and

enrollments still reference it.

Admin tooling only - not part of the citizen-facing wizard. Restricted to Admin. Code must be

Admin tooling only. Full replace: send every DocumentType the category should require - an

get.summary: Gets every required-document row on a category, including inactive ones.
get.description:
Admin management view for the Required Documents tab. Unlike RequiredDocumentTypes on the plain
category response (active + mandatory only), this returns full per-row detail for every
requirement regardless of status.

200.description: Returns the requirement list (empty if none are configured).

example.helpText: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

post.summary: Adds one required document to the category, alongside its existing requirements.
post.description:
Admin tooling only. Unlike the bulk PUT .../requirements endpoint, this does not replace the
list - it appends one row. Rejected if the category already has a requirement (active or
inactive) for this DocumentType; update or remove the existing one instead.

example.helpText: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.
A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

400.description: DocumentType is missing/invalid, or a field exceeds its max length.

409.description: This category already has a requirement for this DocumentType.

put.summary:
Replaces the category's eligibility rule (age range, allowed marital statuses, guardian
            requirement, dependents-allowed flag).
put.description:
Admin tooling only. Full replace/upsert - creates the rule if none exists yet, otherwise replaces
it entirely (including the allowed-marital-statuses list). GuardianRequired is informational
only: there is no automated signal to verify it against, so it is surfaced as a manual-review
note on the enrollment summary rather than blocking submission.

200.description: Updated. Returns the category with its new eligibility rule.

example.name: Government Employee
example.description: Citizens employed by a government ministry or public authority.

documentRequirements.helpText: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

400.description: MaximumAge is less than MinimumAge, or an age is outside 0-120.

put.summary:
Updates one requirement's metadata (label, help text, sample URL, order,
            active/mandatory).
put.description:
Admin tooling only. DocumentType itself is immutable once added - remove and re-add the
requirement to change it. Setting IsActive to false or IsMandatory to false takes effect
immediately for readiness checks and RequiredDocumentTypes.

example.helpText: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.
A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

404.description: No such category, or no such requirement on this category.

Admin tooling only. A category can validly have zero required documents - removal is never
blocked. To temporarily hide a requirement instead of deleting it, use PUT with IsActive = false.

404.description: No such category, or no such requirement on this category.

post.summary: Records an insurance eligibility decision for a patient.
post.description:
Call this from an Admin tool after determining (manually, or via an external check) whether a
citizen is eligible for national health insurance at all. Restricted to Admin. This is the
single write path for eligibility: creates the patient's current eligibility record if none
exists yet, or updates it if one does - either way, a new history entry is always appended.
Status/Reason are supplied by the caller; this endpoint does not compute eligibility internally.

example.reason: Verified against Ministry of Health enrollment records.
example.remarks: Confirmed via phone with the citizen's employer.

200.description: Recorded. Returns the patient's current eligibility.

example.reason: Verified against Ministry of Health enrollment records.

400.description: A required field is missing, or PatientId does not reference an existing account.

get.summary: Gets a patient's aggregated insurance status timeline in one call.
get.description:
Call this once to populate a citizen's insurance status dashboard, instead of calling Insurance
Applications, Insurance Eligibility, Insurance Verification, and Documents separately. Access is
Admin (any patientId) or the Patient themselves (own patientId only) - no Doctor access.

404.description: No such patient, or the caller has no access to this patientId.

post.summary: Records an insurance verification decision for a patient.
post.description:
Call this at the point of care - appointment check-in, clinic visit, emergency admission, or
billing - to confirm coverage is currently usable. Restricted to Doctor and Admin. Always
inserts a new verification event - there is no current-state row to upsert (unlike Insurance
Eligibility). Status/Reason/Context are supplied by the caller; Source is always Manual today,
and ExpiresAt (when Status is Verified) is computed from the configured
Insurance:Verification:DefaultValidityHours - neither is client-supplied.

example.reason: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

200.description: Recorded. Returns the new verification event.

example.reason: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

400.description: A required field is missing, or PatientId does not reference an existing account.

403.description: Caller is neither Doctor nor Admin.

displayName.description: Optional, max 200 characters. Falls back to a static label when omitted.

helpText.description: Optional, max 500 characters. Shown next to the upload field in the wizard.
helpText.example: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

sampleDocumentUrl.description: Optional, must be a well-formed URL, max 500 characters.

displayOrder.description: Sort order among the category's requirements, ascending.

isMandatory.description: Defaults to true (Required). False = Optional - never blocks readiness.

AddCategoryDocumentRequirementRequestDto.description:
Request payload for POST /api/insurance/categories/{id}/requirements (Admin only). Adds one required
document to the category, alongside its existing requirements - unlike the bulk PUT endpoint, this
does not replace the list.

occupation.description: From CitizenProfile. Null if never set.

ApplicantSummaryDto.description:
The citizen's own identity + CitizenProfile fields, as needed for an Admin reviewing their
application - part of ApplicationReviewDetailResponseDto. Admin has no other endpoint that exposes
this (ProfileController is Patient-only), so this is the one place an Admin can see it.

addedToApplicationAt.description: When this dependent was captured into the application's snapshot (at Submit time).

ApplicationDependentDetailDto.description:
One dependent actually captured in an application's submission snapshot (ApplicationDependent
joined to its DependentPerson) - part of ApplicationReviewDetailResponseDto. This is "who was
covered when the citizen submitted," not the sponsor's current dependent list (which may have
changed since).

reviewHistory.description:
Newest first. InternalNotes on each entry is populated only for an Admin caller - a
            Patient caller sees null there.

ApplicationDetailResponseDto.description: Full application detail, including its review history.

dependentPersonId.description:
Set when this document is about a specific dependent rather than the applicant
            themselves.

dependentFullName.description:
Convenience label - the dependent's name, when DependentPersonId is set. Null for the
            applicant's own document.

addedToApplicationAt.description: When this document was captured into the application's snapshot (at Submit time).

ApplicationDocumentDetailDto.description:
One document actually captured in an application's submission snapshot (ApplicationDocument joined
to its CitizenDocument) - part of ApplicationReviewDetailResponseDto. This is "what was on file when
the citizen submitted," not the citizen's current document list (which may have changed since).

applicationNumber.description:
Human-readable reference, e.g. "APP-2026-00000015" - the primary reference to show
            users. Id (below) remains the internal identifier used by every other endpoint in this
            controller (submit/cancel/review/detail).

reviewedBy.description: AdminId of whoever most recently reviewed this. Null until the first review.

decisionReason.description:
Citizen-visible reason for the final decision - set only once Status becomes Approved or
            Rejected.

documentCount.description: Number of documents captured in this application's snapshot at submission time.

dependentCount.description: Number of dependents captured in this application's snapshot at submission time.

ApplicationResponseDtoPagedResultDto.description: Generic paged list wrapper, reusable by any future paginated endpoint.

documents.description: Documents actually captured in this application's submission snapshot.

dependents.description: Dependents actually captured in this application's submission snapshot.

reviewHistory.description: Newest first. InternalNotes is always populated here - this endpoint is Admin-only.

ApplicationReviewDetailResponseDto.description:
Everything an Admin needs to decide on one application, in a single response: the application
itself, the applicant's identity/profile, the category applied for, the documents and dependents
actually captured in this application's submission snapshot (not the citizen's current state),
eligibility, verification, and the full review history. Replaces the need to call the separate
Documents/Dependents/Eligibility/Verification endpoints one by one - see
GET /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/review.

reviewedBy.description: AdminId of whoever performed this review.

citizenVisibleReason.description: Shown to the citizen. Required at the service level when NewStatus is Rejected.

internalNotes.description:
Set only when the caller is Admin - null for a Patient caller, enforced in the
            service.
internalNotes.example: Employment letter confirmed with HR department.

ApplicationReviewResponseDto.description: A single review action taken on an application.

ApplicationStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of an insurance application. Values: Draft, Submitted, UnderReview,
WaitingForDocuments, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled. Valid transitions (see
InsuranceApplicationService.AllowedTransitions): Draft -> Submitted -> UnderReview ->
WaitingForDocuments -> UnderReview -> Approved/Rejected, and Draft/Submitted/UnderReview/
WaitingForDocuments -> Cancelled. Approved, Rejected, and Cancelled are terminal - no outgoing
transitions.

citizenVisibleReason.description: Optional, max 1000 characters. Shown to the citizen.

internalNotes.description: Optional, max 2000 characters. Admin-only - never shown to the citizen.
internalNotes.example: Employment letter confirmed with HR department.

ApproveApplicationRequestDto.description:
Request payload for PATCH /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/approve (Admin only). A thin,
explicit convenience wrapper around the same underlying transition as PATCH .../review with
NewStatus=Approved - see InsuranceApplicationService.ReviewApplicationAsync for the actual
state-machine/snapshot logic, which this delegates to unchanged.

token.description:
The JWT bearer token. Pass it in Swagger's Authorize dialog, or in an
            "Authorization: Bearer <token>" header on every other call.

expiresAtUtc.description:
UTC expiry of the token - the frontend should re-authenticate (log in again) once past
            this time.

userId.description: Internal numeric id of the account (Patient, Doctor, or Admin row).

AuthResponseDto.description: Response returned after a successful register, login, or test-token request.

statusHistory.description:
Every status change this card has undergone (Suspend/Reactivate/Revoke/rotate-token),
            newest first.

CardDetailResponseDto.description: Full card detail, including its status-change history.

cardNumber.description:
Human-readable reference, e.g. "INS-2026-00000015" - the primary reference to show
            users. Id (below) remains the internal identifier used by every other endpoint in this
            controller.

patientId.description:
The sponsor/owning account - always set, even when the card belongs to a
            dependent.

dependentPersonId.description:
Null = this card belongs to the Patient themself. Set = belongs to that specific
            dependent.

isCurrentlyValid.description: Computed at read time: Status == Active && DateTime.UtcNow <= ExpiresAt.

version.description:
Layout/schema version of this card row. Always 1 today - reserved for future card-layout
            changes.

cardTemplate.description: Reserved for future card layouts. Always null today.

tokenVersion.description:
Confirms a rotation succeeded without exposing the token itself - VerificationToken
            remains permanently excluded from every response.

predecessorCardId.description: The card this one superseded via Renew/Replace - null for a card issued via Issue.

successorCardId.description: The card that superseded this one, if any - resolved at read time, not stored.

isLatestCard.description:
True when SuccessorCardId is null - avoids requiring every client to check for null
            themselves.

expiresAt.description:
IssuedAt plus the configured DefaultValidityMonths (12 months by default), computed once
            at issuance and never recomputed.

applicationId.description: The Approved application that authorized this issuance.

CardResponseDto.description:
A digital insurance card's current state. VerificationToken is deliberately never
            included here - it is the opaque secret embedded in the card's QR/NFC payload.

CardStatus.description:
Closed set of Digital Insurance Card states. Values: Active, Suspended, Revoked, Superseded.
Deliberately no "Expired" value - expiry is derived at read/verify time from ExpiresAt, never a
stored status flip. Superseded is system-set only, when a replacement/renewal card is issued - never
a client-requested transition.

reason.example: Citizen reported the card as lost.

changedBy.description: AdminId of whoever made this change.

CardStatusChangeResponseDto.description: A single status change made to a card.

isCurrentlyValid.description:
The single field a point-of-care check should key off: true = accept this card right
            now.

CardVerificationResultDto.description:
The minimal set of information a hospital actually needs at check-in - deliberately no NationalId,
Address, Mobile, or internal Guid Id, even for an authenticated Doctor/Admin caller.

displayName.description:
Resolved label: the Admin-configured DisplayName, or a static fallback derived from
            DocumentType when none was set.

helpText.description:
Short inline guidance shown next to the upload field in the enrollment wizard. Null if
            not configured.
helpText.example: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

sampleDocumentUrl.description: Optional link to an example/template document. Null if not configured.

displayOrder.description: Sort order among the category's requirements, ascending.

isActive.description: False = soft-disabled - excluded from RequiredDocumentTypes and readiness checks.

isMandatory.description: False = Optional - shown to the citizen but never blocks readiness/submission.

CategoryDocumentRequirementDto.description:
Full detail of a single required document row on an insurance category - the Admin
            management view (unlike InsuranceCategoryResponseDto.RequiredDocumentTypes, which is the plain,
            citizen-facing, active+mandatory-only list).

reason.description:
Optional at the DTO level, max 1000 characters - but required (checked in the service)
            for Suspend and Revoke.
reason.example: Citizen reported the card as lost.

ChangeCardStatusRequestDto.description:
Request payload for Suspend/Revoke/Renew. Reason is optional at the DTO/shape level - the service
enforces "required for Suspend/Revoke, not for Reactivate/Renew" (the same DTO is not reused for
Reactivate, which takes no body at all).

patientId.description: Required. Must reference an existing patient.

reason.description: Required, max 500 characters. Explains why this decision was made.
reason.example: Verified against Ministry of Health enrollment records.

remarks.example: Confirmed via phone with the citizen's employer.

CheckEligibilityRequestDto.description:
Request payload for recording an insurance eligibility decision. The decision (Status/Reason) is
supplied by the calling Admin - this sprint does not compute eligibility internally. Creates the
patient's InsuranceEligibility record if none exists yet, or updates it if one does; either way, a
new EligibilityCheck history row is always appended.

DocumentReviewStatus.description:
A document's review outcome. Values: Pending, Approved, Rejected. Exists to prepare CitizenDocument's
schema for a future document-review capability - no endpoint today sets anything other than the
default (Pending), so a frontend should not expect to see Approved/Rejected yet.

DocumentType.description:
Closed set of insurance-application document types. Values: NationalId, BirthCertificate,
MarriageCertificate, EmploymentLetter, DisabilityCertificate, DeathCertificate,
GuardianAuthorization, FamilyRegistration. Deliberately no generic "Other" value - a new
document type gets its own enum value later, matching the approach already taken for VerificationContext.

EligibilityStatus.description:
A citizen's national health insurance eligibility outcome. Values: Eligible, NotEligible,
            PendingReview, Suspended, Expired.

code.description:
Stable machine key. Required, max 50 characters, must be unique across all categories.
            Convention: uppercase with underscores.

name.description: Display name shown to citizens. Required, max 100 characters.

description.example: Citizens employed by a government ministry or public authority.

displayOrder.description: Sort order for displaying categories in a list, ascending.

isActive.description:
Defaults to true. Set to false to soft-disable the category (stops it from appearing in
            the active category list without deleting it).

InsuranceCategoryRequestDto.description:
Request payload for creating or updating an InsuranceCategory (Admin only). Code must be
            unique across all categories (checked in the service).

code.description:
Stable machine key, unique across all categories - not shown directly to
            citizens.

name.description: Display name shown to citizens in the wizard.

description.example: Citizens employed by a government ministry or public authority.

isActive.description:
False = the category is soft-disabled and no longer selectable for new enrollments (it
            still appears on any enrollment that already used it).

displayOrder.description: Sort order for displaying categories in a list, ascending.

requiredDocumentTypes.description:
Every DocumentType the citizen must upload to be ready to submit under this category -
            active and mandatory requirements only.

documentRequirements.description:
Full detail for every requirement, including inactive/optional ones - the Admin
            management and Preview view. RequiredDocumentTypes above is the filtered subset of this list.

allowedMaritalStatuses.description:
Empty = no marital-status restriction. Non-empty means the citizen's profile
            MaritalStatus must be one of these values.

guardianRequired.description:
Informational only - not automatically enforced (there's no automated way to verify a
            guardian relationship). Shown as a manual-review note during Admin review instead.

dependentsAllowed.description: False means an applicant with any active dependent cannot use this category.

InsuranceCategoryResponseDto.description: An insurance enrollment category and the criteria configured for it.

reason.example: Verified against Ministry of Health enrollment records.

checkedBy.description: AdminId of whoever recorded this decision.

updatedAt.description: Null if this is the first decision ever recorded for this patient.

InsuranceEligibilityResponseDto.description: A patient's current national health insurance eligibility state.

currentApplicationNumber.description:
Human-readable reference of the patient's most recent application. Null if they've
            never applied.

timeline.description:
Ordered stages of the application's progress, for rendering a visual progress
            tracker.

documentCount.description: Total number of documents the patient has on file.

InsuranceStatusResponseDto.description:
Citizen-facing insurance status timeline - a read-only aggregation over the patient's most recent
InsuranceApplication, InsuranceEligibility, InsuranceVerification, and CitizenDocuments. Never
includes ApplicationReview.InternalNotes - see InsuranceStatusService.

reason.example: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

expiresAt.description:
Set only when Status is Verified - computed from
            Insurance:Verification:DefaultValidityHours (24 hours by default) at the moment of
            verification.

verifiedBy.description: DoctorId or AdminId of whoever performed this verification.

isCurrentlyValid.description:
Computed by the service, never the client: true when Status is Verified and ExpiresAt
            (if set) has not yet passed.

IssueReason.description:
Why a specific card row was issued. Values: Initial (first card for the primary applicant),
Renewal (via POST .../renew), Replacement (via POST .../replace), Dependent (first card for a
dependent), Migration (reserved for future bulk data-migration scenarios).

nationalId.description:
Egyptian National ID of the account to log in as. Required, exactly 14
            digits.

password.description: Account password, in plain text over HTTPS. Required.

LoginRequestDto.description: Request payload for logging in. Works for any role (Patient, Doctor, Admin).

MaritalStatus.description:
Marital status, part of a Patient's CitizenProfile. Values: Single, Married, Divorced,
            Widowed. Also used by Insurance Categories to restrict which marital statuses may enroll under a
            given category (e.g. the "Widow" category requires Widowed).

role.description: "Patient", "Doctor", or "Admin", read directly from the JWT's role claim.

MeResponseDto.description: Response for GET /api/auth/me, reflecting the claims present in the caller's JWT.

citizenVisibleReason.description: Required, max 1000 characters. Shown to the citizen - explain what needs to change.
citizenVisibleReason.example: The submitted Employment Letter is expired - please upload a current one.

internalNotes.description: Optional, max 2000 characters. Admin-only - never shown to the citizen.
internalNotes.example: Letter dated 2023, more than 3 months old per policy.

RejectApplicationRequestDto.description:
Request payload for PATCH /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/reject (Admin only). A thin,
explicit convenience wrapper around the same underlying transition as PATCH .../review with
NewStatus=Rejected - see InsuranceApplicationService.ReviewApplicationAsync for the actual
state-machine/snapshot logic, which this delegates to unchanged. Unlike Approve,
CitizenVisibleReason is required here - the service also enforces this, but making it [Required] on
the DTO gives a fast, field-level 400 before the service ever runs.

RelationshipType.description:
Closed set of family relationship types between a sponsoring Patient and a DependentPerson.
            Values: Spouse, Child, Parent, Guardian.

reasonNote.description: Optional, max 1000 characters. Most useful when ReplacementReason is Other.

ReplaceCardRequestDto.description:
Request payload for Replace (Lost/Damaged/Stolen). A structured ReplacementReason (for reporting and
analytics) instead of free text, with an optional ReasonNote for extra context - most useful when
ReplacementReason is Other, but not restricted to it.

ReplacementReason.description:
Closed, structured reason captured on a card issued via Replace. Values: Lost, Damaged, Stolen,
Other. "Other" plus the optional free-text ReasonNote covers anything not worth its own enum value.

citizenVisibleReason.description:
Required, max 1000 characters. Shown to the citizen - explain exactly what's missing or
            needs to be re-submitted.
citizenVisibleReason.example: The uploaded Employment Letter is illegible - please re-upload a clearer scan.

internalNotes.description: Optional, max 2000 characters. Admin-only - never shown to the citizen.
internalNotes.example: Original scan is too dark to read the company letterhead.

RequestDocumentsRequestDto.description:
Request payload for PATCH /api/insurance/applications/{applicationId}/request-documents (Admin
only). A thin, explicit convenience wrapper around the same underlying transition as
ReviewApplicationAsync with NewStatus=WaitingForDocuments - see
InsuranceApplicationService.ReviewApplicationAsync for the actual state-machine logic, which this
delegates to unchanged.

ReviewOutcome.description:
The business decision behind a review action. Values: Approved, Rejected, NeedMoreDocuments.
Distinct from ApplicationReview.NewStatus (the workflow-engine state) - this field is null on a
review row that just moves the application into UnderReview (e.g. picked up for review, or moved
back from WaitingForDocuments) since there's no concluded outcome yet. Computed by
InsuranceApplicationService from the requested NewStatus, never client-supplied directly.

documentTypes.description:
Required. The complete set of DocumentTypes this category should require - can be an
            empty list to require none.

SetCategoryDocumentRequirementsRequestDt.description:
Request payload for PUT /api/insurance/categories/{id}/requirements (Admin only). Full replace: the
category's required document set becomes exactly this list - an omitted DocumentType is no longer
required, same "full replace" semantics as UpdateProfileRequestDto.

maximumAge.description:
Optional, 0-120. Null = no maximum age. If both ages are set, this must be >=
            MinimumAge.

allowedMaritalStatuses.description: Optional. Empty list = no marital-status restriction.

guardianRequired.description: Informational only - not automatically enforced. See EnrollmentReadinessService.

dependentsAllowed.description:
Defaults to true. Set to false to block anyone with an active dependent from using this
            category.

SetCategoryEligibilityRuleRequestDto.description:
Request payload for PUT /api/insurance/categories/{id}/eligibility-rule (Admin only). Full replace:
upserts the category's InsuranceCategoryEligibilityRule row and replaces its AllowedMaritalStatuses
wholesale - same "full replace, omitted = cleared" convention as UpdateProfileRequestDto. Service-level
validation: if both ages are set, MaximumAge must be >= MinimumAge.

SubmissionChannel.description:
Where an application was submitted from. Values: WebPortal, MobileApp, AdminPortal, Kiosk,
GovernmentImport. Only WebPortal is produced today - the only intake path this API exposes; the
other values are reserved for future channels without needing another migration.

nationalId.description:
NationalId of any seeded or registered account (Patient, Doctor, or Admin). Unlike Register/Login,
this does not require exactly 14 digits - this endpoint is Development-only, so a short id is
fine for quick manual testing.

TestTokenRequestDto.description: Request payload for the development-only test-token endpoint. No password required.

stageName.description: Display name of this stage, e.g. "Submitted", "UnderReview", "Decision".

isComplete.description: True if the patient's application has reached or passed this stage.

timestamp.description: When this stage was reached. Null if not yet reached.

TimelineStageDto.description: One stage in a patient's insurance status timeline.

displayName.description: Optional, max 200 characters. Falls back to a static label when omitted.

helpText.description: Optional, max 500 characters. Shown next to the upload field in the wizard.
helpText.example: A signed letter from your employer, dated within the last 3 months.

sampleDocumentUrl.description: Optional, must be a well-formed URL, max 500 characters.

displayOrder.description: Sort order among the category's requirements, ascending.

isActive.description:
False = soft-disable - excludes it from RequiredDocumentTypes and readiness checks
            without deleting the row.

UpdateCategoryDocumentRequirementRequest.description:
Request payload for PUT /api/insurance/categories/{id}/requirements/{requirementId} (Admin only).
Updates one requirement's mutable metadata. DocumentType itself is immutable once added - remove and
re-add the requirement to change it.

UserRole.description: Role assigned to an authenticated user, included as a claim in the issued JWT.

VerificationContext.description:
Which operational workflow prompted an insurance verification. Values: Appointment, CheckIn,
ClinicVisit, EmergencyAdmission, Billing. A closed, curated set on purpose - if a new business
context appears, add a new value rather than falling back to a generic "Other".

VerificationSource.description:
Where a verification decision came from. Values: Manual, GovernmentApi, Imported, System. Only
Manual is produced today - no external integration exists yet. Kept independent from
EligibilitySource (not reused) since the two features may evolve this concept differently over time.

VerificationStatus.description:
The outcome of a single insurance verification event, decided at the moment it was checked.
            Values: Verified, NotVerified, Pending.

verificationToken.description: Required. The opaque secret decoded from the card's QR/NFC payload.

VerifyCardRequestDto.description:
Request payload for the hospital-facing verify endpoint - a scanned QR/NFC decodes to this
            token, never raw card data.

patientId.description: Required. Must reference an existing patient.

reason.example: Confirmed active coverage via national insurance portal.

VerifyInsuranceRequestDto.description:
Request payload for recording an insurance verification decision. Status/Reason/Context are
supplied by the calling Doctor or Admin - this sprint does not call an external source. Source is
set internally by the service (always Manual); ExpiresAt is computed internally from
Insurance:Verification:DefaultValidityHours (24 hours by default) - neither is accepted from the
client.

Bearer.description: Enter a JWT token. Example: "Bearer eyJhbGciOi..." (the "Bearer " prefix is added automatically).

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Register (once) → Login → receive a JWT → send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other Domain 1 call.

tags.name: Insurance Categories
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** GET the active category list (Step 1 of the enrollment wizard) → show each category's required documents and eligibility rules → citizen picks one to start enrollment with.

tags.name: Insurance Applications
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Create a Draft → submit it for review → track its status → cancel it if no longer needed. The enrollment wizard drives these automatically; call them directly only outside the wizard flow.

tags.name: Application Review (Admin)
tags.description: **Admin-only. Frontend flow:** GET the queue (optionally filtered by status) → GET one application's full review detail (this also claims it, advancing Submitted → UnderReview) → take one explicit action: Approve, Reject (reason required), Request Documents (reason required, sends it to WaitingForDocuments), or Back to Review (resumes it after the citizen re-uploads).

tags.name: Insurance Eligibility
tags.description: **Admin-only.** Records a citizen's national health-insurance eligibility outcome, used as a read-only snapshot when an application is finally decided.

tags.name: Insurance Verification
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** A doctor or admin verifies a citizen's coverage at the point of care (appointment, check-in, billing) and records the outcome.

tags.name: Insurance Status Tracking
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** One call a citizen-facing dashboard can use to show application status, eligibility, verification, and document count together, instead of calling four endpoints.

tags.name: Digital Insurance Card
tags.description: **Frontend flow:** Once an application is Approved, Admin issues a card → citizen/provider can fetch or verify it by its QR/NFC token.

tags.name: Card Lifecycle Management
tags.description: **Admin-only.** Suspend, reactivate, or revoke an issued card, or replace/renew it - each action is recorded as an immutable status-change history entry on the card.
